longDescription: A twin-map toolkit for product designers. The story map structures a raw requirement into seven fields, splits the solution into a journey backbone, and grounds each feature in Who/What/When/Why/DoD with MoSCoW priority and release swimlanes. The journey map analyzes a persona-by-scenario experience: actions, touchpoints, thoughts, emotion, pain points and opportunities per stage, with mandatory fact/hypothesis labeling, an emotional curve and moments of truth. Journey-map opportunities import as story-map feature drafts, linking experience diagnosis to release planning. State persists in a single JSON file, applied atomically by scripts and re-renderable anytime.
tryPrompts: Map out a raw requirement into a user story map
Analyze this persona's user journey in this scenario
Import journey-map opportunities into the story map
